description:
Deprecated alias of get_stock_fii_flow; use get_stock_fii_flow for per-stock daily FII transaction flow.

Returns the same result as get_stock_fii_flow, which replaces it: a daily series of FII/FPI buy, sell and net for one stock from CDSL's disclosures, ending in March 2025, with a 30-day summary. `days` (1 to 1825, default 90) is counted back from the latest day of data held, not from today.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
